column18: Adaptive dynamic graph lottery tickets with layer-adaptive sparsity for deep GNNs; theory on over-smoothing; no efficiency figures.
Hybrid SNN/ANN event-image segmentation: up to 20x lower inference cost than prior art, 17.9 mJ per cycle.
Review of CPU, GPU, NPU, compute-in-memory and neuromorphic accelerators, focused on performance and memory bandwidth; no figures.
ResNet-18/VGG-11 SNNs within 1% of DNN accuracy at 8 timesteps; FPGA 38.4 GOPS at 1.54 W.
BPTT training of SNNs on IPU: 5-10x throughput over A100 GPU, up to 38x at high activation sparsity.
ANN-SNN conversion with BLIF neurons; accuracy on CIFAR and ImageNet; only time steps as efficiency figure.
Conversion with spike-count regularisation; claims better energy efficiency and latency than other conversion methods; no figures.
TTFS mapping matches ANN accuracy with under 0.3 spikes per neuron; no ANN energy or operation comparison.
SNN with neuromorphic ADC matches CNN with conventional ADC at over 95% lower sampling rate; no network efficiency metric.
GRU vs LIF vs spiking GRU decoders on NeuroBench: accuracy, footprint, activation sparsity, synaptic operations; beats baselines; no figures.
Quantised SNN with ternary membrane potentials; up to 13x memory reduction versus SoTA SNNs; no ANN comparison.
Randomized parameter sharing versus pruning (MAG, SNIP, SynFlow, GraSP, LTR); ANN only, lottery ticket rewinding just a baseline.
Inductive graph lottery tickets reach same performance at 14.26-43.12% graph sparsity and 48.80-91.41% GNN sparsity.
Spiking reservoir computing claims competitive accuracy at lower operational complexity; no quantified ANN efficiency comparison.
Tandem ANN-SNN DOA estimator claims superior accuracy and lower power; no figures given.
LTH subnetworks in XLS-R show language bias; fine-tuning relies on weights from high-resource languages; no efficiency metrics.
EGRU on SpiNNaker2 matches LSTM accuracy; claims significant energy gains versus conventional hardware for single batch inference; no figures.
Pruned quaternion ResNet-101 beats real-valued by 4% (CIFAR-100) and 7% (ImageNet64) accuracy at sparsities of 6% and 0.4%.
TTFS ANN-to-SNN conversion on image classification, reconstruction, speech enhancement; claims orders of magnitude computation saving over ANN.
Learned RF spike encoder with tunable sparsity regularisation; lower reconstruction error and sparser spikes than existing encoders; no figures.
DEEP R and RigL dynamic pruning with delay learning in SNNs on Raw Heidelberg Digits outperforms per-synapse delays when sparse.
Sparsity-regularised full-FORCE for recurrent SNNs: 30.5% lower mean square error and 53% faster training convergence than full-FORCE baseline.
Spike-routing Clos NoC for sparse SRNNs; 13.9x power saving versus packet-based NoCs; circuit level, no ANN comparison.
Quantised SNN keyword spotting on Google Speech Commands; compared with SNN models only; no ANN efficiency comparison.
SNN remote sensing detector claims significantly fewer compute resources than equivalent ANN; dual quantisation gives 80% memory reduction.
